title: Emergent structures in coupled opinion and network dynamics
summary: This paper investigates a model of opinion formation on an adaptive social network, consisting of a system of coupled ordinary differential equations for individuals' opinions and corresponding network edge weights. A key driver of the system's behaviour is the form of the interaction function, which determines the strength of interactions based on the distance between individuals' opinions and appears in both opinion and network dynamics.
